what_happened: Scene layout 6 (same kitchen as s16/s19, robot right of the dishwasher), red cup_4 and black bowl_5. Stage 0: first close on the cup at 161 lifted it, a re-close at 188, carried it over the rack and opened at 204 well above the rack (drop 0.396 m); the cup landed on the rack on its side (tipped 226-1200); stage 0 complete 212 (fast). Stage 1: the gripper came down over the black bowl and closed on its rim at 508 (lift 0.019), but the bowl slipped out at ~536 and settled on the counter 2 cm from where it was. The arm turned toward the rack anyway (548-572 wrist shows the rack and cup), came back over the bowl 620-672 (pinch 670-674, no lift), hovered over the counter 690-880, then made an empty trip to the rack 920-1040 (wrist shows only the cup in the rack; close on air 935). At ~1080 it returned to the bowl, touched it from 1103 (close 1103 no lift), gripped it at 1131-1140 and was carrying it down toward the rack at the timeout (bowl end z 0.81, 0.30 m from the dishwasher box, still in the gripper). The door was never touched.
causal_chain: bowl rim grasp slipped at 536 after a 1.9 cm lift -> second pinch 670 failed -> ~200 steps hovering + empty trip to the rack 920-1040 -> bowl finally gripped 1131 -> in transit at the timeout (1200), door not started
self_recovery: Two more attempts after the slip; the third (1131) held and was being carried to the rack when time ran out.
official_criterion_notes: The cup counts as placed while lying on its side (tilt 49 deg at the end).
